description: The bar chart illustrates “Popularity” values for three content domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) across three models (Llama3, an unlabeled gray-series model, and ChatGPT) and three answer/accuracy conditions indicated by hatch patterns. The category axis is horizontal with labels “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball” in that left-to-right order, and the value axis is vertical labeled “Popularity,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, and 220. Within each category, bars are grouped by model color—blue for Llama3, red for the gray-series model (despite the legend showing a gray swatch), and yellow for ChatGPT—and each model appears as three adjacent bars distinguished by fill: a dotted pattern for “Acc=0 & GT Ans,” diagonal hatching for “Acc=0 & Gene Ans,” and a plain (unhatched) bar for “Acc=1 & GT Ans.” For Movies, Llama3’s bars are approximately 25 (dotted), 35 (hatched), and 40 (plain); the red-series bars are about 28 (dotted), 40 (hatched), and 45 (plain); and ChatGPT’s bars are about 25 (dotted), 28 (hatched), and 35 (plain). For Songs, Llama3’s bars are about 58 (dotted), 50 (hatched), and 72 (plain); the red-series bars are about 58 (dotted), 65 (hatched), and 85 (plain); and ChatGPT’s bars are about 45 (dotted), 52 (hatched), and 75 (plain). For Basketball, Llama3’s bars are about 100 (dotted), 155 (hatched), and 178 (plain); the red-series bars are about 100 (dotted), 188 (hatched), and 212 (plain); and ChatGPT’s bars are about 98 (dotted), 172 (hatched), and 138 (plain). The bars are not presented as a single sorted sequence across categories; instead they are arranged in repeated grouped triplets per model within each domain, with no special outlines or annotations beyond the hatch patterns and legend.
